children: European stock indexes mostly gain at market open, with earnings stories continuing to drive the moves. The continent-wide Stoxx 600 adds 0.1%. London's FTSE 100 gains 0.5%, lifted by oil major Shell, which rises 2.5% after announcing a $5 billion buyback. Haleon slides 12.5% after cutting guidance, however. The German DAX edges up 0.2% as sportswear group Adidas gains 3.4% after posting higher net profit, while industrials in the index gain more broadly. In Paris, the CAC 40 is 0.7% higher amid broad gains for autos and luxuries. Airbus shares gain 4% after third-quarter earnings. Italy's FTSE MIB is 0.4% lower while the Spanish IBEX 35 falls 1%, dragged by a 5.2% fall for BBVA after the bank's earnings disappointed. The Dutch AEX adds 0.2%. (josephmichael.stonor@wsj.com)
